base_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl bzip2 ca-certificates libglib2.0-0 libsm6 libxcomposite1 libxcursor1 libxdamage1 libxext6 libxfixes3 libxi6 libxinerama1 libxrandr2 libxrender1 mercurial openssh-client procps subversion wget
activation_validation_command: source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate benchmark && python -c 'from PIL import Image; print(Image.__version__)'

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: pip install pytest in activated conda environment
runtime_profile.notes: Conda environment 'benchmark' created with Python 3.11 and Pillow 10.2.0 (buggy version). git and curl already available in base system.

notes: Base image candidate is continuumio/anaconda3:latest (Debian Bullseye). git and curl are already available in the host system at /usr/bin/git and /usr/bin/curl. The environment uses conda as the primary package manager with pip for specific Python packages like Pillow 10.2.0 (buggy version). The fix addresses security vulnerability GHSA-44wm-f244-xhp3 by updating Pillow from 10.2.0 to 10.3.0.
